fields.label: Project Description
fields.value: Kingston Grandeur is our Prestigious Residential Project at TC PALYA Main Road, Anandapura, Opposite Bharath petroleum,K R Puram, Bangalore, 560049. Located in close vicinity to Whitefield, ITPL, Manyatha and Hebbal Economic zones. Kingston Grandeur is Combination of 2 & 3BHK. Project is Approved by BBMP, with “A” Khatha.As a part Amenities & Features, we will be providing Club House, Kids & Adults Pool, Children’s Play Area, Badminton Court, Half Basketball Court, Walking Track, Reflexology Gardens, Vastu Complaint, Strategic Location, CCTV Surveillance, No Common Walls, Covered Car Parking, Intercom Facility, Quality Construction, Automatic lifts, Party hall, STP, Power back up, security service, Landscaping Gardens and many more
